Usage: second-brain [options] [command]

Second Brain / Segundo Cérebro - Persistent Memory Platform for AI Agents

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]            Initialize a new Second Brain vault
  search [options] <query>  Search notes in the vault
  read <note>               Read a note from the vault
  create [options] <path>   Create a new note
  sync                      Rebuild search index from vault
  reindex [options]         Regenerate embeddings for all notes (for semantic
                            search)
  graph [options]           Show knowledge graph structure and metrics
  watch                     Watch vault for changes and keep index in sync
  doctor                    Check vault health
  stats                     Show vault statistics
  reflect [options]         Create a session note reflecting on completed work
  mcp                       Start MCP server over stdio for AI agent
                            integration
  adr                       Manage Architecture Decision Records
  session                   List session history
  project                   Manage projects
  config [options]          View or edit configuration
  backup [options]          Export vault and database to a ZIP archive
  open [options] <path>     Open a note in Obsidian via obsidian:// URI
  obsidian                  Obsidian integration tools
  study                     Manage study notes
  help [command]            display help for command
